# Chapter 2: The Garage

The garage was not large, but it was enough. Twenty feet by twenty, built the way garages were built in those days: concrete floor, wood frame, tin roof that sang in the rain and was silent in the snow. It had a single window, high on the east wall, that let in a blade of morning light and nothing else.
